checklist.note: No directives aimed at the reading model; content is method prose for critique agents, not instruction override.
No network calls or data transmission; skill only defines JSON schemas and process.
No embedded keys/tokens; only doc URLs to public research papers.
No scripts/ directory exists in this skill; no shell commands present at all.
All content is plain readable markdown and JSON schema, nothing encoded.
URLs in evidence.md are citations in prose only, never fetched or downloaded by any script.
